Submission deadline: 17 October 2025

Number of scholarships: 1

With the aim of promoting research on topics relating to the awareness and education of consumers and the defense of their interests, ACSI - Associazione consumatrici e consumatori della Svizzera italiana (Association of Consumers of the Italian-speaking Switzerland) has established an annual award open to graduates of the Master’s programmes of the Faculty of Communication, Culture and Society of USI who have carried out their Master's thesis on topics in line with the statutory purposes of the Association.

• Master in Corporate Communication
  • Master in Digital Fashion Communication
  • Master in European Studies in Investor Relations and Financial Communication
  • Master in International Tourism
  • Master in Lingua, letteratura e civiltà italiana
  • Master in Marketing & Transformative Economy
  • Master in Media Management
